{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
print("Rows with NaN revenue after conversion:", sales['revenue'].isnull().sum())

# Verify that 'completed' status exists and is valid
print("Status distribution:", sales['status'].value_counts())

# Check the first few converted revenue values
sales[['revenue', 'status']].head()"}
